name: Natsumi Sukumi
source:
A classmate of the protagonist. 

After the protagonist saw her masturbating, she demands sex from him regularly. She's a lewd tsundere devil who loves sex.

[Translated from [url=http://www.pin-point.biz/07_skm/skm_story.html]Official Site[/url]]
